rows.en: The backbone of their forces was the Phantom Soldiers, and the cyborg mutant robots: especially powerful psychics who had been modified and enhanced.
Before the steadily growing Neo-Human Empire and its uncanny psychic powers, even the dependable Riders were forced into hard fights.
And then, one night under a full moon…
Are you really going to be okay? Gathering information all by yourself…

Right now we need every scrap of information we can get on the enemy's movements.

Besides, with us so badly short-handed… each of us has to act efficiently…
But you… you don't know much about Earth… or Japan, for that matter, do you?

You needn't worry on that score. I've heard a great deal from Mr. Tachibana, so I understand Japanese culture.

The Japanese value courtesy above all else, and when someone makes a request, they respect the other person's opinion over their own. That's what kind of people they are…
That old man… What era of Japan is he talking about?
…Am I mistaken about something?
Well, never mind. Anyway, if you get hold of any information, make sure to contact me, got it?
Ugh… Please don't let anything come out…
Come out? You mean ghosts?
Ghosts too, but also those Neo-Humans everyone's been talking about lately. They're kind of like ghosts too. When you try to touch them, they just vanish…
I've never seen either one, so I can't really comment.

Well… I've never seen them either…

But Mr. Hongo said he's seen the Neo-Humans.
Ah!?
Whoa, what's wrong? This isn't the moment to be so surprised.
No, my wallet…
You… dropped it?
Probably at that convenience store just now. [HERO4], wait here. I'll be back in five seconds…
Ah, hey, [HERO2]…

…………

That said… just walking around the city at night like this, it's not as though information is lying around on the ground, is it?

…!?

Is this a wallet? I wonder who dropped it.
Five…… Liar!! There's no way you could be back in five seconds.
Heh heh heh heh…
Whoa-whoa-whoa…!?

One, two, three, four…

Five… Whoa, it's got five faces!
I am Itsutsu Banbara of the Neo-Human Empire!

The Neo-Human Empire?

The mutant invasion force Mr. Hongo was talking about!?
The Neo-Human Empire!?
To the Neo-Human Empire, you inferior humans are no better than bugs. Die!

…………

Combat analysis: "Abilities unknown." Recommend engaging in combat with Roaring Steel equipped…
Eek!!
Hold it!
What, who are you!?

My name is Goro Watari!

In the dead of night, some freak shows up and goes after a young lady… A real man can't just run away!
Then you'll die first! Any human who defies us Neo-Humans will not be left alive!
Miss… Go on, get away from here, quickly!
"It seems I have more combat power than he does? But they said that in Japan, at times like this, you should respect the other person's wishes…"
What!? But…
Come on, hurry!
Ah, okay!
Waaaaagh!!
Nngh… You'll pay for this!!
You called for me, Director?
Ah, Captain Kiriyama… I'm sorry for calling you in so suddenly at this hour.
Not at all… More importantly, has something happened?

Mm… Captain Kiriyama, listen carefully.

The truth is, we'd like the men of the Ultra Garrison to take on a new mission.
A new mission… sir?

That's right…

On top of that organization called Shocker the other day, I hear a group calling itself the Neo-Human Empire has begun operating in the shadows lately…
It's a problem… letting people like that run rampant!

Yes, sir…

But unless it's confirmed that they are extraterrestrial life-forms, we can't…

No, we can't afford to say that anymore…

Research labs, factories and power plants all over the country are falling into their hands one after another! Our TDF can't just leave this be!

And as a result of the defense council…

it has been decided that related facilities in every region threatened by invasion will be defended, strictly defensively, by our TDF.
In short… the Ultra Garrison is to protect the related facilities from the invaders.
You'll do it, won't you, Captain Kiriyama!
Sir!! I, Kiriyama, and the Ultra Garrison… will take up guard of the related facilities at once!

Mm… I'm counting on you, Captain Kiriyama!

And there's one more thing…
Huh… an exercise???
That's right…
At this hour?
Mm… It's because it's this hour that we can do it.
I see… In broad daylight, we couldn't go shooting up the middle of town, huh?
No, no… There are plenty of people sleeping at night, too.
Th-that's right! Let's do the exercise some other time. Right, Captain!
No, that won't do! You see…
Captain Kiriyama, I'm sorry I'm late.

Mm, perfect timing!

Let me introduce her… This is Maya Kitakura, chief of the TDF's Security Team!
I'm Kitakura. I've been instructed by the TDF to take part in tonight's exercise.
What!? Take part in the exercise? With us?

Mm…

Even though we've received a special mission, when extraterrestrial life-forms invade, we must be the first to act!

At times like that, it's her TDF Security Team that will take over guarding the related facilities in our place.
I'm Anne. Nice to meet you, Ms. Kitakura.
Captain! A message from the Security Team! They're now at the exercise area… standing by until they receive instructions!

All right, let's head out too!

But… just because there's no enemy in this exercise, don't let your guard down!!
Yes, sir!!
All right, take a look at this!

This is the laboratory that will be our objective in this exercise!

We will swiftly reach the objective, seize the laboratory and rescue Dr. Genzaburo Yuri!!

…!?

Grandfather? Grandfather is there?

Mm… I kept quiet until the last minute because I didn't want personal feelings getting involved…

The truth is, we've asked Dr. Yuri to cooperate in this exercise too.

Speaking of Dr. Yuri…

he's an authority on aerospace science, and holds a special doctorate in biochemistry too… We can't let our guard down, even if it is just an exercise!
